summary: Never fold more than 250 agents roster cards in one read snapshot

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Responses are unchanged. The background refresher completes a roster only when at most 250 cards are changed or missing, otherwise in 250-card steps; readers keep the previous roster meanwhile.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory caches change; reverting restores unbounded final folds.
